card.text: Explore Bettina in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Nonconvex ADAM shape constrained by resolved AO imaging and light curves. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 1850 shape model
shape.summary: Nonconvex ADAM shape constrained by resolved AO imaging and light curves, 110 ± 5 km volume-equivalent diameter. Only one resolved AO observation constrains this reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 1850 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 55 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
